sourceAccessLimits: Actual author reads, not capture or preparation presumed inspected. All12 original complete-family chunks256 families/738 senses and all13 selected-older-body chunks108 complete articles were returned and read through EOF across preceding segments.

All164 original labels,31 component records, exact20 research/source records, complete 延/換/灰/鈍 bodies and main plus canonical-lookup public bodies were actually read. Unchanged 伸 was additionally read completely for its already-existing two reciprocal pairs.

Supplement: さっぱり, 全然 and 完全 were each directly returned as full bodies and read; 完全1211510 was separately captured with both dictionary hashes verified, and its complete one-sense family was returned and read. The supplemental three-body rendering is equivalent prepared evidence, not claimed as another actual chunk return.

The actual union is257 complete families/739 senses,111 older bodies and165 labels. Of164 original older candidates,110 bodies were read and54 remain unselected. 完全 is one additional candidate, not an invented count of originally selected bodies. Earlier seven direct reads duplicate bodies in the108 originals.

Preparation plans remain prepared_for_inspection. A separate completed-inspection receipt records actual reads and hashes. Every available family/body rendering is at most16000UTF8 bytes; source captures are not silently counted as reviewer inspections.

23 public requests produced22 positive captures and the preserved raw 乗換 failure. Supplemental canonical 乗り換え succeeded. All positives derive from Digital Daijisen through Weblio: one authority, not22 independent dictionaries, native certification or frequency evidence. Mixed homophone/historical/read-specific material was separated.

Twenty rows map to15 new and5 reused articles. Stable IDs/readings/titles/primary metadata and easier jlpt3/5 labels are preserved; のろのろ gains only sourcedjlpt2. Unchanged 乗せる/登る bodies receive scoped claimed-source coverage checks, not new whole-body authoring or review claims.

Source-selected 延びる sense8 is restricted to the actually taught 延びる spelling; explicit teachingSpelling records this rather than pretending primary 伸びる accepts8. Existing improvement6 remains restricted to 伸びる. Raw broad/misleading/blank fields remain provenance, not unchecked teaching.

Primary kana forms のこぎり/のろい/のんき have empty kanji arrays. Source 鈍い and 呑気 remain explicitly taught aliases. Do not invent のろ in pinned 鈍 readings; its separate Common words/Notes alias links are checked outside the primary-metadata audit.

Direct quiz safeguards are symmetric nontransitive author hypotheses based on actual meanings, not unrestricted Japanese substitutions. Existing primary titles, ordinary secondary senses and construction differences were assessed; no blanket POS, causative/state, scope or category exemption is claimed.
No exhaustive corpus ambiguity audit, live-quiz uniqueness or measured model-bias improvement is claimed. Inherited batch61 quiz debt remains deferred. Initial independent reviews have not yet run.

quizGuardRationale: 残らず direct all/completely safeguards include actual whole/completeness secondary senses and the separately read 完全. 全然 and さっぱり require context/polarity, not blanket negative-synonym inheritance or unrestricted interchangeability.

覗く includes intransitive partial visibility and 出る has ordinary protrusion/appearance senses; not every English look implies secrecy or the same duration. 上り ascent/upstream protections are direct hypotheses, not an ascent clique or a claim that all route directions mean Tokyo.

糊/貼る addresses an untyped English paste-label ambiguity while explicitly retaining material/action constructions. Saw/cut is not inferred merely because a saw cuts. Category and part of speech alone neither force nor excuse a guard.

乗り換え switching has a direct スイッチ secondary-sense comparison. 載る print/recording and loaded-placement facets were assessed against 出る/記録/出版/発表/乗せる, without assigning ride meanings to 載る or publication to the spelling 乗せる.

のろい differs from existing にぶい but overlaps slowness and obtuseness. 蛍光灯's dated slow-on-the-uptake-person sense is ordinary captured evidence beyond its light title. Do not inherit all of にぶい's dimness/boring/aching exclusions.

のんき's contextual carelessness was assessed directly against selected older careless-label facets, not as a blanket clique or a claim that every careless act is carefree. Absence of worry is not automatically the same event as relief from a prior worry.

句 explicitly includes haiku sense4; 詩 can include this poetic form. 売店 overlaps actual shop labels, not every adjacent retail category. 売買 overlaps trade/commerce/sales without defining every isolated buying/selling action as the whole compound.

這う's plant creeping/spreading sense motivates direct 広がる/伸びる safeguards; walking and sneaking are not automatic synonyms. Literal 灰色 does not acquire an ash-material guard or every public figurative gray sense.

Twenty rows map to15 new and5 reused articles. Stable IDs/readings/titles/primary metadata and easier jlpt3/5 labels are preserved; のろのろ gains only sourcedjlpt2. Unchanged 乗せる/登る bodies receive scoped claimed-source coverage checks, not new whole-body authoring or review claims.

Source-selected 延びる sense8 is restricted to the actually taught 延びる spelling; explicit teachingSpelling records this rather than pretending primary 伸びる accepts8. Existing improvement6 remains restricted to 伸びる. Raw broad/misleading/blank fields remain provenance, not unchecked teaching.

Existing primary titles, ordinary secondary senses and construction differences were assessed; no blanket POS, causative/state, scope or category exemption is claimed.
